shared.noConversation: no active talk. need talk ID.
shared.dynamicToolActivationDisabled: tool switching turned off. boss person can turn on in Settings → Agent Defaults.
shared.invalidToolsArray: 'tools' must be non-empty list of tool name or domain prefix.
shared.searchActionNudgeDisabled: IMPORTANT: some found tool NOT turned on (isEnabled: false). you MUST call enable_tools with tool name before can use. after turn on, tool ready next round.

enable_tools.noValidTools: none of requested name match real tool. check spelling or use search_tools to find.
enable_tools.alreadyEnabled: all requested tool already on and ready — use them now.
enable_tools.activated: turned on {{count}} tool. ready next round.

disable_tools.noneInSet: none of requested tool were in active set.
disable_tools.protectedSuffix: {{count}} core tool protected and cannot turn off.

discover_and_enable_tools.foundAndEnabled: found {{matchCount}} tool and auto-turned-on {{enabledCount}}. ready next round — use them.
discover_and_enable_tools.foundAlreadyEnabled: found {{matchCount}} tool, all already on — use them.

set_timer.invalidDuration: 'durationSeconds' must be between {{min}} and {{max}} second. for longer remind or repeat event, use create_cron_job.

enter_worktree.noConversation: no talk — separate cave need active talk
enter_worktree.alreadyInWorktree: already in separate cave (branch: {{branch}}). call exit_worktree first.
enter_worktree.success: now in separate cave. all file work go to {{path}}. call exit_worktree with 'merge' or 'discard' when done.

exit_worktree.notInWorktree: not in separate cave. call enter_worktree first.
exit_worktree.mergeFailed: merge fail: {{error}}. cave kept at {{path}}. fix conflict and try again, or exit_worktree with 'discard'.
exit_worktree.merged: change from {{branch}} merged into main. cave restored.
exit_worktree.discarded: cave {{branch}} thrown away. all change gone. workspace restored.

search_conversations.noEmbeddings: no talk with brain-stamp found. talk get brain-stamp after agent session with 6+ message.

summarize_conversation.summaryRequired: 'summary' required and must have word in it

ask_user.questionsRequired: 'questions' list required and must not be empty
ask_user.invalidQuestion: each question must have non-empty 'question' word
ask_user.noConversation: no talk — ask_user need active talk

authenticate_mcp_server.noCredentials: need at least one of 'token', 'api_key', or 'env'

write_todo.invalidItems: 'items' must be list of todo thing
